stem.text: The diagram shows the arrangement of chromosomes with attached spindle fibres during a stage of mitosis.

stem.alt: Diagram of chromosomes with attached spindle fibres drawn as dashed lines converging on two poles.

stem.text: Which row correctly identifies the stage of mitosis and describes what is happening?

A.text: anaphase; chromosomes are being pulled towards the centromeres

B.text: metaphase; sister chromatids are replicating prior to separation

C.text: metaphase; chromosomes are being positioned along the equator of the cell

D.text: anaphase; sister chromatids are being pulled towards the poles of the cell
